independent_source_level_floor.proof: With no shared 48-byte substring, _find_resync cannot succeed and consumes 256-byte fallbacks. At most 32 fallbacks yield at most 33 copy runs, each at most 47 bytes; any 8192-byte nonbase member must therefore write >=8192-33*47=6641 literal bytes. Existing BDC charges all programs to each selected member. Since there are >=29 nonbase members, even the lower bound [base 8192 + selected 8192 + 29*6641] exceeds 8*8192 before metadata.
